desc: Derive the contiguous-interval greedy closure characterization and strict blocker condition.
Prove that greedy absorption of all currently absorbable boundary slimes is optimal for a fixed start.
Derive and validate a provably worst-case \(O(N\log N)\) all-start algorithm using component hierarchy and binary lifting.
Implement the bounded-complexity Python algorithm using 64-bit sums and verify it on the public samples.
